findings: The exact original qualifier has no explicit screenshot, getImageData, toDataURL, toBlob, video recording or Playwright tracing call. Its snapshot action exports numeric/application/DOM-text state rather than pixels.

Snapshot2 completes before action3 starts; the frame recorder starts inside action3 before locator.click. The eight compositor ReadPixels lie before the actual featured.onclick handler, during the click preparation/auto-wait interval.

The exact Playwright1.62.1 click flow performs pointer actionability and RAF-based position stability checks through getBoundingClientRect. Its screenshot methods are separate. These checks may induce style/layout but do not intentionally take screenshots or call readPixels.
The recorder explicitly selects categories and excludes all others; no screenshot category is enabled. The retained trace's capture-related name scan finds only eight GLES2::ReadPixels events.

The largest retained readback is nested in compositor BeginMainFrame/Commit/DoUpdateLayers. Some title-scene paint and automation RAF/layout work are also retained, but no ownership map identifies the readback surface. Title rendering is therefore not established as its cause.

This CPU-stressed, headless, traced, incomplete run cannot exclude indirect observer/compositor effects or prove the same costs in ordinary play. No untraced comparison, exact renderer backend, complete flow or physical-device qualification is available.
